shadows.name: pasted-paper

motion.name: sketch-response

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: A decisive Redline Ink workshop label for the primary next step.
components.css: .ds-action-primary { background: var(--sketch-accent, #ea1b0a); color: var(--sl-color-text-invert, #fff6f4); border: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--rough-radius-blob, 125px 10px 20px 185px / 25px 205px 205px 25px); padding: 0.65rem 1.15rem; font: 700 1rem Kalam, cursive; transform: rotate(-1deg); transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background 0.25s ease; } .ds-action-primary:hover { background: #ff2e1c; transform: rotate(1deg) scale(1.03); } .ds-action-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px dashed var(--sketch-accent, #ea1b0a); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Search Trigger
components.description: A transparent dashed search control drawn directly on the drafting surface.
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 2rem; min-width: 18rem; color: var(--sl-color-text, #d3cec4); background: transparent; border: 2px dashed var(--sl-color-hairline, rgba(255,255,255,.14)); border-radius: var(--rough-radius-blob, 125px 10px 20px 185px / 25px 205px 205px 25px); padding: 0.55rem 0.8rem; font: 400 1rem Kalam, cursive; } .ds-search kbd { font: 500 .75rem 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; } .ds-search:hover { border-color: var(--sketch-accent, #ea1b0a); color: var(--sl-color-text-accent, #ff6a55); } .ds-search:focus-visible { outline: 2px dashed var(--sketch-accent, #ea1b0a); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Active Navigation Label
components.description: A rough workshop label marking the reader's current location.
components.css: .ds-nav-active { display: block; color: var(--sl-color-text-accent, #ff6a55); background: var(--sketch-accent-soft, rgba(234,27,10,.08)); border-bottom: 2px dashed currentColor; border-radius: 10px 14px 10px 6px / 12px 10px 6px 12px; padding: .375rem 1rem; font: 700 1.0625rem Kalam, cursive; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-active:hover { text-decoration: underline wavy 1.5px; text-underline-offset: 5px; } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px dashed var(--sketch-accent, #ea1b0a); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Sketch Card
components.description: A transparent technical container with a handled, imperfect frame.
components.html:
Deploy with confidence

Validated infrastructure primitives with operational defaults included.
components.css: .ds-card { color: var(--sl-color-text, #d3cec4); background: transparent; border: 2px solid var(--sl-color-hairline, rgba(255,255,255,.14)); border-radius: var(--rough-radius, 255px 15px 225px 15px / 15px 225px 15px 255px); padding: 1.25rem; transition: transform .25s ease, border-color .25s ease; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 .5rem; color: var(--sl-color-white, #f3f0e9); font: 700 1.35rem Kalam, cursive; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; font: 400 1rem/1.6 EON, sans-serif; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: var(--sketch-accent, #ea1b0a); transform: rotate(-.5deg); }

components.name: Redline Aside
components.description: A pinned note for cautions and infrastructure constraints.
components.css: .ds-aside { color: var(--sl-color-text, #d3cec4); background: var(--sketch-accent-soft, rgba(234,27,10,.08)); border: 2px dashed color-mix(in srgb, var(--sketch-accent, #ea1b0a) 65%, transparent); border-radius: var(--rough-radius, 255px 15px 225px 15px / 15px 225px 15px 255px); padding: 1rem 1.25rem; } .ds-aside strong { color: var(--sl-color-text-accent, #ff6a55); font: 700 1rem Kalam, cursive; } .ds-aside p { margin: .35rem 0 0; font: 400 1rem/1.6 EON, sans-serif; }

components.name: Inline Code
components.description: A compact instrument label for identifiers inside prose.
components.css: .ds-inline-code { color: var(--sl-color-white, #f3f0e9); background: var(--sl-color-bg-inline-code, rgba(255,255,255,.06)); border: 1px dashed var(--sl-color-hairline, rgba(255,255,255,.14)); border-radius: var(--rough-radius-inline, 6px 12px 8px 14px / 12px 6px 14px 8px); padding: .08em .35em; font: 500 .9rem 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

narrative.overview: The documentation feels like a working surface where AWS systems are actively reasoned through rather than a polished corporate portal. The mood is precise, handmade, and quietly confident; components resemble rough workshop labels and pinned notes.
keyCharacteristics: Charcoal or warm paper surfaces with a faint fixed drafting grid.
Redline Ink as the singular high-energy annotation color.
Handwritten display typography paired with a highly legible technical body face.
Dashed rules, irregular contours, pasted-paper media, and restrained physical offsets.
Dense technical content held inside deliberate, readable measures.

rules.name: The Redline Rarity Rule
rules.body: Redline Ink marks action, state, or annotation; it never becomes ambient decoration across large surfaces.

rules.name: The Two Papers Rule
rules.body: Dark charcoal and warm paper are equal theme expressions of the same drafting table, not separate brands.

rules.name: The Hand and Instrument Rule
rules.body: Kalam speaks for the human; EON explains; JetBrains Mono measures.

rules.name: The Pinned, Not Floating Rule
rules.body: Surfaces may look placed on the table, but they never hover like glossy SaaS glass panels.

dos: Do preserve the 45rem prose measure while allowing technical material to use the wider canvas.
Do use Redline Ink to communicate action, state, warning, or annotation.
Do combine irregular radii, dashed construction lines, and slight rotation with restraint.
Do keep dark and light modes materially consistent.
Do preserve keyboard focus, responsive navigation, and readable contrast.
donts: Don't introduce glossy SaaS cards, glassmorphism, or generic developer-portal chrome.
Don't replace the charcoal/paper drafting surfaces with sterile white or featureless flat gray.
Don't use monospace typography as a technical costume outside code and data.
Don't widen prose simply because the viewport is wide.
Don't scatter Redline Ink as decoration until it loses its signaling role.
